script.speaker: friend
script.text: The museum is free on the first Sunday of the month, isn't it?

script.speaker: student
script.text: It was, but they changed it. Now it's free for students any day, with a card.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: I left my student card at home.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Then it's sixty lira today. Or we go tomorrow and you bring the card.

script.speaker: friend
script.text: Tomorrow. I'm not paying sixty lira for a card I own.

question.stem: What do they decide to do?

options.A: Pay sixty lira and go in today
options.B: Go on the first Sunday of the month
options.C: Visit the museum tomorrow with the card
options.E: Ask for a free ticket at the door

question.explain_tr: Arkadaş kartını evde unuttuğu için yarın gitmeye karar veriyorlar. 'Ayın ilk pazarı' kuralı ise artık geçerli değil.
question.key_line: Or we go tomorrow and you bring the card.
